title: Reading Drill — Comparing Family Cycling Routes
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing Family Cycling Routes
passages.body:
**A** A cycling group compared two routes connecting a housing estate to a station. Early reports focused on journey times; later reports included where adults with children felt safe at junctions.

**B** The faster route crossed a wide road with no middle island. Riders using the longer route usually waited at a raised crossing, where cars reached the junction more slowly.

**C** The group recommended improving the fast route, but its public leaflet gave families both options. It added gradient information after readers mentioned difficulty climbing a short hill.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
